body.statement: For replacement-adjacent samples, \(\mathsf M_{h,k,J_\pi,J_\mu}^{\mathrm{DP}}\) and \(C_n(h,k)\) are \((\epsilon_n,\delta_n)\)-differentially private. The accountant is parallel composition across \(D_\pi,D_\mu,D_*\), one joint Gaussian mechanism within each block, and post-processing thereafter. There is a constant \(C_\Delta\), depending only on the fixed class radii, overlap, and dimension, such that conditional on the projected pilots the main joint moment release has \(\ell_2\)-sensitivity at most \(C_\Delta m^{-1}(h^{-d}+k h^{-2d})\), uniformly over \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{att}}\).
body.justification: Every pilot and every higher-order moment is protected under one explicit replacement-privacy accountant.
body.gap: SchroederMelnychukFeuerriegel2025 privatizes ordinary orthogonal CATE learners; it does not bound the sensitivity of a localized quadratic correction with shrinking bandwidth and growing basis dimension.
body.consumer: Privacy officers can audit the release ledger without treating nuisance fits or the quadratic correction as unprotected preprocessing.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove the claimed joint main-block sensitivity and Gaussian calibration for the concrete higher-order learner.
obligation.obstruction: The learner is specified only by reference to all clipped linear and order-two KBRW moment entries.  No kernel formulas, normalizations, clipping radii, pilot release scales, or Gaussian covariance are defined, so replacement sensitivity and approximate-DP calibration are not mathematically determined.
obligation.attempted: I verified the parallel-composition and post-processing ledger and rewrote a generic replacement path argument.  Those steps do not determine the sensitivity of an undefined concatenated vector.
obligation.partial_result: Parallel composition across the three deterministic disjoint blocks would give overall \((\epsilon_n,\delta_n)\)-privacy once each block release were shown to have that guarantee, and all projections, spectral clipping, inversion, and interval formation would then be post-processing.  What cannot be derived is the claimed main-block sensitivity: the construction never defines the linear kernel, the order-two kernel, the normalization of their concatenation, the clipping radii, or the Gaussian covariance.  Those quantities determine whether the joint \(\ell_2\)-sensitivity is \(m^{-1}(h^{-d}+kh^{-2d})\), a square-root-dimensional variant, or another order.
